verdict.rationale: Brex says its developer workspace has Postman collections for all of its APIs, which is a first-party machine-readable equivalent, and its API reference lives under /openapi/ paths, implying OpenAPI-generated docs. However, the probe found no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file at any standard path (all 404). The llms.txt index helps AI discovery but is not an API spec. Missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI/JSON spec URL, confirmation that the Postman collections are exportable and complete, independent corroboration.
